english_retrieval.title: Staying Close from Afar: The Role of Social Media in Maintaining Long-Distance Relationships - Departement of Communications
english_retrieval.snippet: # Staying Close from Afar: The Role of Social Media in Maintaining Long-Distance Relationships. In today’s globalized world, it’s increasingly common for people to be separated by distance, whether for school, work, or other life changes. These platforms allow us to maintain relationships, share everyday moments, and feel close to those far away. One of social media’s most powerful roles in long-distance relationships is offering a way to share daily life. It creates a sense of involvement, like you’re living alongside each other even if you’re in different countries or time zones. Sharing funny memes or meaningful posts through DMs is a way of saying, “This reminded me of you.” Even creating joint content—such as collaborative TikTok’s or shared playlists, makes people feel closer.
